title: docs(pm-dispatch): a project-coordinator reference — the cross-lane scheduling rules a Claude Code project runs by, so its instructions name only its lanes
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-elon-musk"} -->
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9DKyk33tmijDaSFzML54k2pQ)_

Fixes #25219

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## What changed

Four files, all under `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/**` plus one ceiling row; no code, no package.

1. **New reference `references/coordinator.md`** (49 lines, every line ≤ 120 bytes, no table row, no issue number). It is the project coordinator's interface with the seat threads — the role that opens seat threads and card threads and schedules across lanes — beside `seat-lifecycle.md`, because the coordinator is not a `domain:*` seat and so not under `lanes/`. Seven sections in the card's order, each naming its reader, each pointing at the rule's single source instead of restating it:
   1. 车道归属登记在座位贴 — a project's instructions name only the lanes it manages; each seat thread sits the lane's vacant seat post and writes 「由 X 账户的项目负责」 in the post's 说明 section; one lane, one project; the seat post (not project memory) is the arbiter; another project's in-flight cards are finished by its own seat, and its sign-off brief is the release (seat-lifecycle's own rule).
   2. 跨车道取卡 — the intake face is the project's lanes' open `priority:p1`/`priority:p2` cards under `execution-duties.md`'s candidate rule; each card goes to its lane's seat thread; a lane with no seat thread and a vacant post gets a seat thread first; the maintainer names no lane per card.
   3. 全项目一个上限,p1 先 — one project-wide card-thread cap, the number the maintainer states for the project (the sum of the seats' `batch` terms only when none is stated); seats hand candidates over at any time; p1 ahead of p2; a thread waiting on a human or on the seat's review holds no slot; in-seat S subagents count only against the seat's `batch`. ⛔ No number is written as the rule.
   4. effort 与档位按难度 — points at `execution-duties.md` 〈派发〉 and `dispatch-gates --tier`; skill (protocol-semantics) cards at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`; the coordinator sets model and effort at thread creation on the seat's request carrying the maintainer's word (`dispatch-runbook.md`).
   5. 卡线程的 `needs_decision` — re-pointed after #25348 revoked every delegated-ruling channel: the rule lives in `lanes/director.md` and the 〈卡线程〉 section of `dispatch-runbook.md`, ⛔ not restated; the seat writes the four-axis analysis and a recommendation and the card joins the ruling batch the maintainer rules by hand, ⛔ no ruling thread, no delegated ruling; a thread waiting on a ruling holds no slot; the ruling record is the ruling comment on the card, ⛔ never a project file or memory.
   6. 额度压力 — near the usage wall (the reading of `seat-lifecycle.md` 〈断粮与跨墙恢复〉) the coordinator opens no new card thread, lets in-flight ones finish, and tells the maintainer once.
   7. 语言与汇报 — the maintainer's language in the project, English on GitHub (SKILL.md's invariant); the coordinator reports on a result, a blocker or a decision, as the seats do.
2. **`SKILL.md`, one row in 〈入口与角色〉**: `coordinator` — 以项目协调者身份运行(项目会话:开席位线程与卡线程、跨车道调度;接口见 `references/coordinator.md`), 154 bytes against the file's 342-byte widest-row pin. **Paid by one deletion in 〈升级与决策〉**: 「项目总监席:维护者在所在仓召唤 `/pm-dispatch director`;⛔ 无 Routine/cron;未回字 = 不在 = 停。」 — every clause of it survives in `references/lanes/director.md` (授权面 = 人工定期召唤,⛔ 无 Routine、无 cron; 入口 … `/pm-dispatch director`; 未回字 = 不在 = 停), which the `director` row of the same entry table already points at. SKILL.md stays line-neutral (319/319 after merging `main` with #25348); no ceiling moved. PR #25247 lowers the ceiling to 318 at its own landed count; this PR changes no count, so either landing order holds.
3. **`references/dispatch-runbook.md`, one line edited in place** (241/241, line-neutral): the 〈卡线程〉 cap line read 「全项目上限 = 各席 `batch` 之和」, which contradicts the card's item 3 (the maintainer sets one number per project — the two values set so far differ). It now reads 「全项目上限由维护者按项目定(`coordinator.md`)」 and the sum is the new file's stated default when no number is given. This is the one SKILL/reference line that would otherwise contradict the new file (the handover's allowance).
4. **`scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs`**: a `CEILINGS` row for the new file at its landed count (49) and a `MAX_TABLE_ROW_BYTES` pin of 0 (it carries no table row). A new file is not a raise and funds nothing. No other script is touched.

The maintainer's word, verbatim and untranslated, as the card quotes it: 「刚才你让我转帖的项目指令规则，为什么不定义在仓库中呢，我只要穿到具体的车道就行。」

## The PM's mechanism assumptions, measured

- **A1 (both blockers landed)** — holds. #25214 (`03de83bfe`) wrote the `mode:thread` backend, the effort field, the S/M split and 「项目的 coordinator 跨席位统一调度」; #25242 (`e58bd0e`) wrote a ruling-thread rule that #25348 (merged 2026-10-23) then revoked; item 5 now points at the rule #25348 left in `lanes/director.md` and the runbook's 「终报 `needs_decision` ⇒ 四维分析与推荐并入决裁批次呈维护者裁」 line. Items 2–5 of the new file point at those lines and restate none.
- **A2 (SKILL.md 318/319; PR #25247 lowers to 317)** — holds. The `coordinator` row is paid by the director-summons deletion above; the file lands at 318 either way. PR #25247's diff is the 〈域车道〉 table, `lanes/*.md`, `check-half-states.mjs`, `ensure-pm-labels.sh` and the ratchet's SKILL.md / `lanes/server.md` rows — disjoint from every hunk here (the ratchet rows this PR adds sit beside `seat-lifecycle.md`, not beside the lane rows). Whichever lands second merges `main` and re-runs `check:pm-skill-ratchet`. Open PRs touching `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/**` at claim time: #25247 only (MCP `search_pull_requests`, `is:open pm-dispatch`, 7 hits, one on the skill).
- **A3 (new file needs its own ceiling row; id-lint)** — holds, done. `check:pm-skill-id-lint` is green (88 files clean); the new file names rules by file and section only.
- **A4 (item 1 vs multiple seats per lane)** — **no contradiction, so no `needs_decision`.** `seat-lifecycle.md` 〈开轮互斥〉 is per seat number (读数三 「同席号」) and says nothing about projects; `seat-post-protocol.md` L9 admits several seat posts per lane. Item 1 adds a constraint one level up — one lane, one project — which several posts per lane can satisfy (one project may run several seats of its lane). What item 1 does contradict is today's **board state**: seat 1 (#7623, `os-bill`'s project) and seat 2 (#19287, this project) both sit `domain:skills`. Seat 1's handover (comment 6343601899) already declares that project leaves the lane once its in-flight cards land, so the double occupancy is the transition the rule converges to, not a second rule. The file spells the arbiter at lane level — a 🟢 post of another project on ANY seat of the lane means the lane is taken — and the release as seat-lifecycle already defines it (the sign-off brief). Read strictly, the rule would have told this project to wait for that brief before sitting seat 2; the contract review should read that sentence and say whether it stands as written.

## Gates

Re-merge 2026-10-23: head `72bc519a` merges `main` `5e772c79` (carrying #25348) into the item-5 re-point `3e6e35eb`; on it the same 42 families all exit 0 (`--ran` 42/42), SKILL.md 319/319 (its row paid by the 项目总监席 deletion), dispatch-runbook.md 241/241, coordinator.md 49/49.

First run, head `3788440`: `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` over the four changed paths derived 42 families (23 pnpm, 19 direct node). Every one was run with its exit code captured before any pipe and recorded as `COMMAND :: exit CODE`; `--ran` reconciles 42/42, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN. All 42 exit 0. One needed a second run: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint run check:doc-formula-expressions` first exited 3 (PREREQUISITE — `@objectstack/lint` unbuilt in a fresh worktree, the same reading PR #25214 recorded); after `pnpm --filter '@objectstack/lint...' build` it exits 0. `check:pm-skill-ratchet`: SKILL.md 318/319, dispatch-runbook.md 241/241, coordinator.md 49/49 (widest table row 0/0). `check:pm-skill-id-lint`: 88 files clean. `check:skill-frame-sync` green (the four-axis frame is untouched). CI's remaining families are the PR's check-runs. No published package moved (`.claude/**` and one `scripts/pm` ledger row), so `skip-changeset` rides this PR's create.

## 维护者速读(草稿)

**改了什么:** pm-dispatch 技能新增 `references/coordinator.md`:项目协调者(在项目会话里开席位线程、开卡线程、跨车道调度的那一席)与席位线程之间的接口,按卡上七条写成七节,每节注明读者,只指向规则所在的文件、不复述。SKILL.md 入口表加一行 `coordinator`,用删掉一条已在 `lanes/director.md` 写明的总监召唤行抵账,行数不变;runbook 里「全项目上限 = 各席 batch 之和」改为「由维护者按项目定」。棘轮为新文件加封顶行,无上限抬高。

**为什么改:** 你 10-22 的话:「刚才你让我转帖的项目指令规则，为什么不定义在仓库中呢，我只要穿到具体的车道就行。」——规则进仓库,项目指令只写管哪几条车道。

**风险与代价(含回滚):** 纯规则文本,不碰代码与门禁;回滚即 revert 本 PR。一处值得你看:新文件写「一条车道恒归一个项目」(卡上第 1 条原话),而今天 skills 车道两个项目各坐一席(seat 1 的交接已说它收完在飞卡就退出)。按这条严格读,本项目本应等 seat 1 收班再坐席;契约复核会读这句并给意见。

**席位意见:**

**你要做的:** 席位复核 PASS 后,在席位线程点名回一句「objectstack-ai/objectstack#25255 可以落地」。

## Acceptance notes

- The attribution block's first line is an HTML comment the session requires as the body's first line; `os-dev.md` 〈干净收尾〉 forbids HTML comments in GitHub text. Measured on PR #25214 (the same shape), the relay read-back keeps it byte for byte. Reported as a deviation, not hidden.
- The claim's `Worktree:` line says 「the card thread's own checkout」; the repo's PreToolUse guards block edits in the primary checkout, so the work was done in a linked worktree (`../objectstack-issue-25219`) on the designated branch, the primary checkout left detached at `e58bd0e`. No deviation from the branch rule: the branch is the one the claim names.
- The commit's co-author trailer is the model-free pair the pre-push hook (`check:commit-card-trailers`) requires; the harness's own trailer spelling was refused once and reworded before the first push — the session trailer is the attribution.
